verdict.rationale: Community evidence acknowledges the existence of threading in Teams channels but describes it as confusing and inconsistently implemented compared to direct chats (which lack threading), with one engineer calling the threading UX so bad they abandoned channels for group IMs. No first-party documentation in the pack explicitly describes the reply-in-thread mechanic, so the story is only supported indirectly. Missing for 10: dedicated product docs on threaded replies, evidence of reliable in-thread notification/attachment behavior, and independent confirmation the UX issues have been resolved.
